question: A, B, C, D. E, F and G are seven students from a college who appeared for an exam and scored different marks each. D scored the second highest marks. C scored immediately lower marks than D and immediately higher marks than F. E scored higher than only B. G scored less marks than four of the fellow students. Who scored the highest marks?
solution:
Given: Seven students A, B, C, D, E, F, and G from a college appeared for an exam and scored different marks.

No two students scored the same marks.

1) D scored the second highest marks.
